name: Karla Esser

summary.text: Karla Esser is the incumbent State Board of Education member for District 7. She is a lifelong educator who directs the graduate program for practicing teachers at Regis University.

experience.text: Colorado State Board of Education, District 7 (incumbent).
Doctorate in educational leadership and policy, University of Northern Colorado.
Director of graduate programs for licensed teachers, Regis University; previously a teacher, professor, school administrator, and assistant superintendent.

education_focus.text: Esser cites two state-commissioned studies finding Colorado would need about $14,600 more in per-pupil funding to meet the Colorado Academic Standards, and points to Proposition NN and Amendment 87 as 'a start to solving this problem.'
On school accountability, she says she 'would never vote to close a school simply because of low test scores,' citing performance gaps tied to family income.
Her campaign site says arming teachers 'is not the solution' to school safety and favors a multi-stakeholder approach instead.
